description: Build and flash Eclipse CDT projects directly in VS Code.
command.selectInstallation: Eclipse CDT: Select Eclipse IDE Application
command.toggleAutoImport: Eclipse CDT: Toggle Automatic Project Import
command.selectIconTheme: Eclipse CDT: Select Toolbar Icon Theme
config.installationPath: Eclipse IDE application path, such as eclipse.exe, GD32EmbeddedBuilder.exe, or Flagchip_FC_IDE.exe. The extension discovers its headless builder and tools.
config.workspacePath: Eclipse workspace used by headless builds. Empty creates a dedicated workspace for each project in VS Code extension storage.
config.configuration: CDT configuration name. Empty selects a Debug configuration when available.
config.launchConfiguration: Eclipse launch configuration used by Flash.
config.elfPath: Flash file used by Flash. Project files are stored as relative paths. Common formats: ELF, AXF, OUT, HEX, and BIN.
config.autoImport: Import the project into the selected Eclipse workspace when it is not already present.
config.toolbarIcons: Icon pair used for the editor title Build/Flash buttons.
